topic: Robert Cialdini Arizona Campus Door-in-the-Face Experiment: How Reciprocal Concessions Triple Real-World Agreement and Engage Brain Fairness Networks (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Fifty-year meta-analytic synthesis confirming that Door-in-the-Face compliance holds across civic volunteering and high-stakes negotiations whenever the same requester steps down from a sincere opening goal.

clips.environment: a soft daylight university campus walkway paved in cool slate stone with muted-sage palms, a matte-ceramic comparison stand, and pastel study books
